notes:
### New Features
- **Custom accent color** - Pick your own accent color in appearance settings with a color picker
- **Chapters** - Add chapters to tracks with a YouTube-style timecode editor, jump between them from the player and context menu
- **Listening stats** - Profile page now shows your listening statistics with a calendar heatmap
- **Queue history** - Played tracks are kept in a queue history
- **Autoplay recommendations** - When the queue runs out, playback continues with recommended tracks
- **Library folders** - Organize your library into folders
- **Discord integration** - Show the currently playing track in your Discord activity
- **Lyrics follow mode** - Lyrics scroll with playback chat-style and release when you scroll manually
- **Window state** - Window size and position persist between launches
- **Track context menu** - Row actions and context menu on tracks, also available by right-clicking the cover

### Improvements
- Player rebuilt around a single long-lived instance: faster track switching, serialized play requests, no flicker of the loading indicator
- Import engine reworked into modular services with better error handling and support for large files
- Library queries are paginated and indexed, large libraries load noticeably faster
- Playlist and artist submenus load their content only when opened
- UI zoom now uses native webview zoom instead of CSS scaling
- In-app updater shows check/download states directly in the button

### Bug Fixes
- Equalizer settings apply to the current track correctly
- Playback speed is kept after switching tracks
- Search returns all matches and the index resets when data is cleared
- Queue snapshot is saved right after a track starts playing
- Context menus close when the track or playlist they point to is removed
- Fixed several memory leaks (canvas analyzer, marquee text, accent color observer)
